description: This file contains acceptance tests for the Meetings module in a SuiteCRM project, using Codeception framework. It defines the class MeetingsCest with multiple test scenarios to verify viewing, creating, editing, and deleting meetings.

classes.name: MeetingsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Meetings module, including scenarios for viewing, creating, editing, and deleting meetings.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize fake data generator and seed.

methods.name: testScenarioViewMeetingsModule
methods.description: Test to verify the Meetings module list view is accessible and displays the correct title.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateMeeting
methods.description: Test for creating and deleting a meeting with generated company name.

methods.name: testScenarioEditStartDate
methods.description: Test for inline editing of the meeting start date, then deleting the meeting.
